idea: At the kitchen table, a mother slides an envelope to her son. She says: "Open it after I leave." He looks up and asks: "Mom, are you sick?"

script.title: The Unopened Letter
script.logline: A mother hands her adult son a mysterious envelope with parting instructions, sparking his sudden dread.
script.setting: A dimly lit, quiet kitchen over a worn wooden table in the evening.

characters.name: Elena
characters.look: Woman in her early fifties with tired hazel eyes, silver-streaked dark hair tied in a loose bun, wearing a soft beige knit cardigan, and a faint scar along her left brow.
characters.voiceDescription: Hushed, raspy female voice, early 50s, subtle Midwestern accent, slow and deliberate pace.

characters.name: Lucas
characters.look: Young man in his early twenties with messy wavy brown hair, sharp angular jaw, wearing a faded navy crewneck sweatshirt, and a small dark mole beside his right eye.
characters.voiceDescription: Youthful, cracking male voice, early 20s, neutral American accent, hurried and anxious.

shots.visual: Elena slides a plain white envelope across the table with trembling fingers, her eyes glistening as she holds back tears.
shots.motion: Slow tilt up from her trembling hands on the envelope to her strained, compassionate face.
shots.speaker: Elena

shots.visual: Lucas glances down toward the envelope on the table, then snaps his gaze up to his mother with sudden panic in his eyes.
shots.motion: Slight camera push-in focusing closely on his searching, terrified eyes.
shots.speaker: Lucas
